name: Harpy Raiders
summary: Witchwing harpies strike supply caravans on the northwestern trails of the Barrens. Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads sends you to hunt their raiders and roguefeathers, taking their talons as proof.

sections.title: Threat from Above
sections.body: Witchwing harpies strike caravans crossing the Barrens. From rocky crags in the northwest, they swoop on merchant trains and supply wagons. They kill pack animals and seize goods bound for orcish outposts, making each journey through the region dangerous.

sections.title: Darsok's Plan
sections.body: Darsok Swiftdagger, an orc rogue, has spent days watching the flock's habits and ranks. He believes an unfocused assault on their mountain roosts would scatter them. His plan is to break the Witchwing from the lowest rank upward, starting with the raiders before turning to their commanders.

faq.q: Why is the Horde targeting the Witchwing harpies?
faq.answer: Witchwing harpies nest in the northwestern crags of the Barrens and regularly attack Horde supply caravans traveling the main trails.
Darsok Swiftdagger is an orc scout and rogue stationed at the Crossroads. He watches local threats and has studied the harpy flock's chain of command to plan a deliberate attack.

faq.q: Why does Darsok want Witchwing talons?
faq.answer: Darsok wants the severed talons as proof of each kill. He collects them as trophies and to confirm that the flock's lowest raiding ranks are shrinking.
The harpies roost in thorn-choked bluffs and ravines in the far northwestern Barrens, north of the road to Stonetalon.

faq.q: What happens after culling these raiders?
faq.answer: After the raiders and roguefeathers are thinned, Darsok directs you toward higher ranks in the flock, including its lieutenants and matron.

faq.q: Are the harpies working for anyone else?
faq.answer: The Witchwing harpies are wild, territorial scavengers who answer to their roost matron, Serena Bloodfeather, rather than an outside faction.

angles.text: Keeping the Barrens' interior routes secure helps supply the newly established outposts and keep them united under Orgrimmar's banners.
As a rogue, you can appreciate Darsok Swiftdagger's method: scout the target, study its ranks, and eliminate its leadership piece by piece.
